Vendored from demucs-js (https://github.com/bakkot/demucs-js, npm "demucs" 1.0.0):
apply.js, dsp.js, wav-utils.js (planarize only). Code license below.
Local modification: apply.js ignores non-finite samples in the overlap-add (marked in the code).
The model weights are NOT included in oto-eum (Meta's weights: personal /
research use only) — users load a model file themselves.
